description: PINNED XFAIL on impl#1 (g-client-template-interpolation-lowering-needs-a-structural-emitter, carried): this case states the CORRECT behaviour. A body-top template interpolating a reactive cell (`${@total}`) lowers the cell and renders the value. Before S441 round 4 the constant folder folded the interpolated template to "" and the paragraph rendered EMPTY (silent); it now fails loudly on the pre-existing client-template gap. The round-4 WIP's client reuse of emitServerTemplateLit was dropped: it is the exact S437 round-5 shape reverted for silent miscompiles.
rationale: §40.8 S441 bullet: a body-top run is code, checked and emitted exactly as inside `${ … }`. §6.1: `@total` reads the cell. S441 round 4 (#4): the client path emitted the bare `@total` inside the template (invalid JS), masked while the constant folder folded every interpolated template to "".
